name: Beef Chile Relleno Egg Bake
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef (cooked, browned and crumbled)
why: Egg-and-cheese-bound casserole: 16 oz shredded cheddar plus 4 eggs and milk set the dish; ground beef and canned green chiles ride inside as components, so the identity is the bake, not the meat. Published 464 cal / 28 g protein / 9 g carb per serving lands mid-band and clears the 25 g+ protein identity with carbs far under 35. Structurally low-carb (no rice/pasta/potato base; only 1/2 cup flour as a light binder across 8 servings). Bakes in a single dish, so it scales cleanly to 14 servings by weigh-and-divide. No seafood. All main ingredients map to the Omaha board (cheddar, eggs, milk, flour, ground-beef-8020, canned-green-chilies) - no unmapped flags. Adds a Mexican/Tex-Mex egg-bake to a lane that otherwise holds bacon-gruyere, sausage-spinach, and cheeseburger bakes.
